description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useTheme', which manages theme toggling between 'light' and 'dark'. It uses React's useState and useEffect hooks, interacts with localStorage for persistence, and updates the document's data-theme attribute to apply the theme.

methods.name: useTheme(defaultTheme = 'light')
methods.description: A custom React hook for managing theme state with persistence and applying theme to the document.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle between 'light' and 'dark' themes.

methods.name: forceLight
methods.description: Function to force the theme to 'light' and update localStorage and document attribute.
